lesson_title: The Accounting Cycle: Six Stages, One Machine
hook_text: Every rand a business earns rides the same six-stop route. Here it is.
clip_script: Let us run the whole of March through the machine in one pass. A cash sale happens: the till slip is the source document. Its amount joins a line in the CRJ. At month end the CRJ totals are posted to Bank and Sales in the ledger. The ledger balances are listed in the trial balance, and the columns agree. At year end Sales flows into the Trading account and the final accounts extract the profit. Finally that profit is printed in the statements the owner reads.
visual_style: Animated conveyor belt building stop by stop, one till slip travelling through six labelled stations to a finished report.
pacing: Steady build, one beat per stage, rapid recap to close.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson to master all six stages.
